    AuthResponse

    CreateTaskRequest
    ============================================================================== Create Task Request (Input DTO) ============================================================================== Represents the incoming JSON payload when an HTTP client creates a new task via POST /api/v1/tasks.
    CreateUserRequest
    ============================================================================== Create User Request (Input DTO) ============================================================================== Payload accepted when creating a new user through administrative endpoints.
    DataInitializer
    Automatically seeds default demo users (admin and alice) on application startup if they do not already exist in the database.
    DuplicateTaskException
    ============================================================================== Duplicate Task Exception (409 Conflict) ============================================================================== Thrown when attempting to create or rename a task with a title that is already in use by another task in the database
    DuplicateUserException
    ============================================================================== Duplicate User Exception (409 Conflict) ============================================================================== Thrown when attempting to register or update an account using a username or email that is already registered
    GlobalExceptionHandler
     
    JwtAuthenticationFilter
    @Component tells Spring to automatically create and manage an instance of this class as a Spring Bean so it can be injected into SecurityConfig.
    JwtProperties
    ============================================================================== JWT Configuration Properties ============================================================================== This class maps configuration values from application.properties (or application.yml / environment variables) directly into strongly-typed Java fields.
    JwtService
    ============================================================================== JWT Service (Cryptographic Token Generator and Parser) ============================================================================== Manages the creation, digital signing, and validation of JSON Web Tokens (JWT) using the JJWT (Java JWT) library.
    LoginRequest
    ============================================================================== Login Request (Authentication DTO) ============================================================================== Carries username and password credentials supplied by a client attempting to log in via POST /api/v1/auth/login.
    RegisterRequest
    ============================================================================== Register Request (Public Registration DTO) ============================================================================== Received by the public POST /api/v1/auth/register endpoint when a new visitor creates an account.
    ResourceNotFoundException
    ============================================================================== Resource Not Found Exception (Base 404 Exception) ============================================================================== Unchecked exception thrown whenever a requested database entity or domain resource cannot be located.

    ============================================================================== Task Not Found Exception ============================================================================== Thrown when a task lookup by ID yields no result.

    ============================================================================== Task Priority Enum ============================================================================== Represents the urgency or importance level of a task.
